sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Apprehensive, depressed; fear of being
alone in the dark ; great desire to be with people. Tired
and irritable.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Vertigo, with pain in back of head, left when
in bed. Occipital and vertex pain, accompanying severe
lumbar aching. Severe pain over right eye, spreading

Ijack to occiput and to vertex, better in open air. Head
feels heavy. Frontal headache. Both eyes ache. Itch-
injf and dryness of nasal cavities, better in open air.
Aching? pain in angle of right lower jaw. V'iolent tri-
facial neuralgia.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Dryness of mouth. Metallic taste. Prick-
ling sensation on end of tongue.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Empty feeling in stomach. Warm sen-
.sation in stomach. Aversion to sweets, ice-cream. Nau-
sea and sinking sensation, belching of gas.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Pain, violent cramps, rumbling, full of
gas , pain over McBurncy’s point, and at location of
sigmoid flexure. Much flatulence! Alternating con-
stipation and loose movements. Pruritus ani and piles.

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Increased elimination of solids, particu-
larly of chlorides. Renal irritation, albuminuria, granu-
lar and hyaline ('asts. Nephritis with rheumatic symp-
toms.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Pruritus vulvte. Delayed and irregular
menstruation and backache. Aching pains in abdomen
over pubes when flow comes on. Right breast sore,
relieved by hard rubbing.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Persistent cough with tickling in
suprasternal fossa. Dry, spasmodic cough. Throat dry,
sore, chest constricted.

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Aching in back of neck. Pain and lame-
ness in cervical vertebrae, worse dropping head forward,
better standing, or sitting erect. Lumbar and sacral
backache, pain appears to be in bofte, continued motion
relieves. Backache between shoulders and lumbar-sacral
region, better alter walking.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Severe pain in all the limbs, joints,
ill luiee and ankles, sharp pains in shoulders,

arms, hands and fingers. Legs, arms and neck feel
hard and brittle, as though they would break on moving.
Arms feel heavy. Cracking in shoulder. Pain in toes,
calves, hip-joint, popliteal spaces. Muscles of legs and
hips sore. Arthritis, aching pains, uforse at night.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Small pimples. Erythema and dermatitis,
with itching, burning, swelling and redness. Necrosis
and ulceration. Itching all over body, burning of skin,
as if afire.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Restless. Sleepiness with lethargy. Dreams
vivid, busy.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Cold sensation internally, with chattering
of teeth until noon. Internal chilliness followed by heat
of the skin, associated with bowel movements and flatu-
lence.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Better, open air, continued motion, hot
bath, lying down, pressure. IVorse, getting up.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: X-Ray; Rhus; Sepia,
Uranium; Ars.; Pulsat,; Caustic.

Antidotes: Rhus vcn.; Tellur.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Neglectful and forgetful. Pain in left side
of head and in forehead above left eye. Distortion and
twitching of left facial muscles; when speaking left
angle of mouth drawn upwards and to left. Fear of
being touched in sensitive places. Congestion to head
and nape of neck, followed by weakness and faintness
in stomach. Itching of scalp; red spots.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Lids ihukened, in flamed, itching. Pterygium ;
pustular conjunctivitis. Cataract, following ocular
lesions; aid the absorption of infiltrations in iris and
choroid.
